title: Application Shell & Shared UI Armor
invariants: Do not flatten public-route personality into generic shared UI.
Shared and feature-owned components obey the same architectural quality rules.
Component-level styles remain Sass Modules with .module.sass.
Promote shared primitives only with reuse or shared semantic evidence.
SO-015 public-route armor, SO-016 Auth armor and GOLDEN-STATE-v1 remain sealed.

findings.title: Shared UI style ownership has legacy boundary leaks
evidence: src/shared/ui/tooltip/tdm-anchored-tooltip-surface.sass is the only plain .sass file under src/shared/ui.
findings.decision: First proven bite. Seal component-level shared styles behind .module.sass ownership and forbid feature imports of internal shared UI CSS Modules.
resolution: The tooltip Sass mixin remains live and was moved from shared/ui component ownership to shared/styles/tdm as a reusable Sass styling contract.
Feature-owned SVG glyphs no longer import the internal TdmButton CSS Module; TdmButton/TdmIconButton own icon sizing through their wrappers.
Executable gate forbids plain .sass files below src/shared/ui and imports of shared UI .module.sass files outside their owning shared component.

findings.title: Shared UI public entrypoints are inconsistent
evidence: src/shared/ui/tdm-field has no index.ts while consumers import its implementation file directly.
src/shared/ui/tooltip has no index.ts while Canvas consumers import tdm-anchored-tooltip directly.
findings.decision: Audit finding only. Address after SHELL-001 unless subsequent evidence changes priority.
resolution: tdm-field exposes its public React API from src/shared/ui/tdm-field/index.ts.
All inventoried feature/Auth consumers use the package entrypoint instead of implementation-file deep imports.
Executable gate forbids deep imports into these two shared UI implementation files outside their owning directories.

findings.title: App route adapters still contain selected deep feature imports
evidence: src/app/canvas/loading.tsx imports CanvasWorkspaceLoading from a deep canvas UI path.
findings.decision: Audit finding only. Determine whether a feature facade is semantically justified before changing.
resolution: CanvasWorkspaceLoading is exported by the existing Canvas feature facade.
src/app/canvas/loading.tsx consumes the Canvas feature through its public facade instead of a deep UI path.
Executable gate forbids src/app from deep-importing Canvas implementation paths while allowing the canonical feature entrypoint.

findings.title: Public shell owns deliberate body-scroll specialization
evidence: globals.sass contains public-page-specific body selectors established by SO-015.
findings.decision: Preserve. This is existing SO-015 architecture, not a refactor target without new evidence.
findings.resolution: Root app shell metadata/providers ownership remains intentionally thin; no broad shell refactor was proven necessary.

findings.title: Route status surfaces are already substantially centralized
evidence: Root and public route loading/error/not-found wrappers use tdm-status-screen.
Canvas keeps a feature-specific workspace loading surface.
findings.decision: Preserve ownership distinction. No genericization is authorized by this audit.
findings.resolution: Shared public-route status/layout ownership remains legitimate and intentionally preserved.

nextBite.title: Design System & Token Governance
nextBite.reason: SO-017 is complete; continue the application-wide sequence without pre-authorizing token refactors.

closeout.verdict: No additional Application Shell / Shared UI runtime refactor is proven necessary.
